caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jar centered on a plain, neutral background. The jar has a rounded body that narrows slightly at the base and widens at the mouth, with two small looped handles on either side near the top. The coloration of the jar is mostly a muted gray, with a slight sheen indicating a glazed surface. A decorative blue motif resembling a branch with leaves is painted on the main body of the jar, and additional blue accents are visible on the handles. The rim of the jar is adorned with a band of repeating floral or leaf-like patterns in gray, and the inner lip of the jar is tinted a warm brown, indicating earthenware or unglazed clay visible inside. The background is a textured off-white, and no other objects are present in the composition.
title: Crock
